tasks.title: Rebuild/recapture and independent repair regression
tasks.original_scope: Wire approved proposals through native rebuild, renewed captures, complete invalidation and before/after regression.
required_closure_evidence: A repair that fixes one defect but breaks captions, meaning or controls is rejected.
No reuse of pre-repair measurements or affected PASS evidence.
Actual subprocess/render/game evidence, not only staged files, closes the repair.
tasks.implemented_local: Separate before/after working copies and actual registered compile/render/capture/regression stage execution. Fresh stage outputs feed subsequent stages; original sources stay intact; complete case census and targeted baseline failure are checked. Optional pinned native-worker stage transport has no diagnostic fallback.
remaining: The successful stage diagnostics are authored Python/JSON programs, not native BIE compile/render/recapture or canonical full-regression executions. Native stage transport is implemented but was not successfully executed.
Owner-provisioned native entrypoints, new actual audiovisual/game captures, complete canonical corpus and independent semantic assessment are required; no historical obligation is closed.

tasks.title: Production worker/decoder isolation integration
tasks.original_scope: Connect approved Python/Node/browser/media workers to reviewed process, filesystem, network and aggregate resource boundaries.
required_closure_evidence: Benign controls work and denied paths/process/network behavior fails in the actual worker profile.
No candidate execution via the fixed diagnostic bootstrap.
Cross-platform unsupported isolation blocks rather than falling back insecurely.
tasks.implemented_local: An out-of-band hash-pinned native checkout is passed to the existing compiler Linux isolation adapter. Kernel proof/control checks and failure propagation are implemented. The separate trusted diagnostic runner bounds logs/deadlines, scrubs inherited environment and terminates process groups; it is explicitly not a sandbox.
remaining: The native compiler checkout is not mounted. Read-only connector source inspection succeeded, but a public archive download failed DNS resolution. No native isolated workload was executed.

Complete runtime/dependency provisioning, actual approved worker controls and production isolation remain open. Trusted subprocess cleanup is not hostile-code confinement or administrator-race protection.

tasks.title: Dependency and generated-code security closure
tasks.original_scope: Create complete locked executable/dependency inventories and registered static/vulnerability evidence for production runtimes.
required_closure_evidence: Unresolved imports, undeclared scripts/dependencies, malformed parsers and unsafe dynamic capabilities fail.
Declared versions alone cannot substitute for actual installed dependency identities.
Current vulnerability review and broader analysis are explicitly evidenced, not implied by this audit.
tasks.implemented_local: Exact installed file/metadata/dependency/script census plus independently pinned, dated per-package review records. Supports restricted exact npm/PyPI/SYSTEM requirements and explicit-version OSV observations; unsupported ranges remain unknown. No package or installation script is executed by inspection.
remaining: All positive vulnerability-review credentials/records are synthetic. No current online vulnerability feed, complete transitive runtime inventory or broader whole-program security analysis was executed.

The supported dependency grammar deliberately rejects version ranges/conditional dependency syntax outside its exact subset. Native installed React/Remotion/browser/OS dependency clearance remains open.

tasks.title: Full-environment and cross-host reproduction
tasks.original_scope: Reproduce actual producers with locked third-party/OS/runtime/tool/asset identities; classify model and native nondeterminism explicitly.
required_closure_evidence: Same-input reruns and golden artifacts cover native video/game at required sizes.
Cross-host mismatches and dependency drift fail or receive a governed review policy.
No relabeling of equal stdlib fixtures as full product reproduction.
tasks.implemented_local: Restores the approved dependency snapshot into independent copies, executes pinned producers, compares selected measured host/tool identity before and after, and requires exact output inventory/hash reproduction. Host drift, failed/missing/extra/nondeterministic output and absent required cross-host evidence block.
remaining: Two same-host authored dependency snapshots were reproduced; no OS/container image was reconstructed and no cross-machine/native audiovisual/game reproduction was executed.
Selected host fingerprints do not prove full shared-library/GPU/font/service closure or arbitrary model determinism. Full production environment scope remains open.

tasks.title: Representative performance and aggregate memory
tasks.original_scope: Measure actual native queues and render/browser process trees under declared workloads and platform profiles.
required_closure_evidence: Fast incomplete outputs earn no throughput credit.
Aggregate/cgroup or equivalent budgets and backpressure are tested.
All submitted jobs, latency tails, retries and failures remain in workload accounting.
tasks.implemented_local: Authoritative submitted-job and execution census, exact latency/throughput accounting and failed-output exclusion from throughput credit without excluding jobs. Actual cgroup-v2 child scope API reads back limits/counters and checks OOM; actual /proc group RSS is distinctly observational, not enforcement.
remaining: The cgroup filesystem is real but not delegated writable here; the attempted fresh group failed closed. No cgroup-constrained workload or aggregate enforcement success is claimed.

The actual process-tree measurement is a sample, not a peak/enforcement guarantee. Workload verdict rows require an external approved output validator; production native queue benchmarks, backpressure and GPU accounting remain open.

tasks.title: Immutable publication and artifact transaction
tasks.original_scope: Use content-addressed immutable release inputs and atomic verified publication so later bytes match the assessed candidate.
required_closure_evidence: A post-audit mutation cannot publish under an older certificate.
Release retries cannot produce mixed-version artifacts.
Rollback/revocation behavior is checked without claiming deployment from local SQLite.
tasks.implemented_local: Actual existing certificate assessment/verification before copying and after restoring content-addressed release bytes. Local transactional activation, immutable version identity, compare-and-swap head, idempotent retry, read-time expiry/revocation verification and deactivation. Mutable source files are never hardlinked as published blobs.
remaining: Publication exercised the existing certificate verifier using synthetic diagnostic-only authorities and artifacts. No production certificate, distributed store, deployed endpoint or real product release was issued.

Private local SQLite/CAS does not resist an administrator replacing all database/history, deliver distributed transactions/trusted time/KMS, or revoke already downloaded bytes. Native caller integration and production approval remain open.
